scope: Visual inspection of seven Chromium previews from the synthetic Collect fixture.

screens.observation: The recorded total and two synthetic contributions are legible. The Home tab is selected and the four navigation destinations are visible.
The public-directory availability notice and the private example group are both visible. The example group title and total contrast against the photo.
The recorded total, four group actions and provider settlement qualification are legible before the first activity item.
The MoMo PIN notice and four security destinations are fully visible.
The data collection and sign-in disclosures are legible. The automatic SMS detection section begins at the foot of the viewport.
The opening product scope, contribution rails and group ownership are legible. Disputes and corrections starts below them.
The inactive local fixture shows the request service notice and the full Get help button.
